title: Petition of Southern Union Company for authorization and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 11 and 14, to issue and distribute up to 10 million shares of common stock as a dividend payment to the Company's equity shareholders in 2002, 2003 and 2004, of which not more than 3.0 million would be issued for the purpose of effecting the stock devidend in 2002.
filings: Southern Union Company hereby submits to the Department of Telecommunications and Energy the minutes from the Company's Board of Directors Executive Committee wherein it approved the issuance of 2,619,262 shares of common stock to shareholders of record as of the close of business on July 1, 2002.
